what: A thick-bordered frame changes its width and height share per scene — once the board enters the screen it starts one time, moving 63/100 → 91/80 → 77/98 → 100/84 → 100/70% over .6s power2.out (.6s pause between scenes, only .1s for the first), and each time one scene layer (photo·name) cross-changes in .4s. After a full loop it rests another .5s and repeats endlessly — 6 seconds per scene
needs: CustomEase (when giving a curve as values)

options.shapes: Shape order ‹width/height› % comma-separated, default ‹63/100, 91/80, 77/98, 100/84, 100/70› — the first shape is the last one
options.dur: Duration of the shape change (sec), default .6
options.fade: Duration of overlapping scene change (sec), default .4
options.hold: Extra rest at the end of a loop (seconds), default .5
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.25,1,0.5,1”, default power2.out
options.start: ScrollTrigger start (relative to the panel), default top 80%
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Overlapping scenes (children) — the next scene each time a shape changes. The first scene hooks onto the initial shape (last in the list)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Frame that changes size — put one per scene and all change together. Border color and weight are the user’s css (different color per scene)

use:
1. Photo

    Scene Name

    2. …

from.where: index.html .h-concept__cards (five-scene frames — li is the scene, .h-ccard__img is the frame) — original home.js looping timeline defaults .4s delay .6 power2.out, frame .6s, first card delay .1, end wait .5. The original starts when the top of the tagline section touches the top of the screen
from.options: start: top top (the original uses the whole tagline section as reference)
